steps.say: **Your account** is your own corner of this page — not the organisation's, yours. Your sign-in and your device live here, and nothing in it is visible to anyone you have invited.
If you arrived through a **link in an email**, that link will not last forever. A password is how you get back into your organisation from a new laptop, a new phone, or after clearing your browser.
Tap **Set a password** and the form opens right here. You will sign in with your email address and that password from then on — and you can come back and change it any time.
steps.terminal: That is the whole thing — one password, always changeable, always in the same place.
